description: List Confluence spaces, up to a limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of spaces to return (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of space objects), size, and _links; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single space by its key.

space_key.description: The unique key of the space.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the space object; on failure (space not found), output contains an error message.

description: List content (pages), optionally filtered by type and space key.

space_key.description: Optional space key to filter content by.

limit.description: Maximum number of content items to return (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of content views), size, and _links; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single content item (page) by its id.

content_id.description: The unique id of the content item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the content view; on failure (content not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new page in a space, optionally nested under a parent page.

space_key.description: The key of the space the page belongs to.

body.description: Optional storage-format body content of the page.

parent_id.description: Optional id of the parent page to nest under.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created content view; on failure (space or parent not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the title and/or body of an existing page, incrementing its version.

content_id.description: The unique id of the content item to update.

title.description: Optional new title for the page.

version_number.description: Optional expected new version number; must equal the current version plus one.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated content view; on failure (content not found or version conflict), output contains an error message.

description: List the direct child pages of a given page.

content_id.description: The unique id of the parent content item.

limit.description: Maximum number of child pages to return (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of child content views), size, and _links; on failure (content not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the labels attached to a given page.

content_id.description: The unique id of the content item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of label objects) and size; on failure (content not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the comments on a given page.

content_id.description: The unique id of the content item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of comment objects) and size; on failure (content not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search pages using a simplified CQL string (supports space=, title~, and type= clauses joined by AND).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with results (list of matched content wrappers), size, totalSize, and cqlQuery; on failure, output contains an error message.
